The minimal RPM Fusion gate — a Fedora image whose only reason to exist is to
prove `layer-rpmfusion` live once every other Fedora workload bed retires.
It composes pod-sshd so the pod has a long-running service to deploy and probe;
everything else arrives through the `fedora-nonfree` base chain, which owns the
`layer-rpmfusion` pin and therefore the candy's check set — both release packages
in the rpm database, both `.repo` definitions on disk, the free repo's section
header, and the FREE signing key imported and queryable via `rpm -q gpg-pubkey`.
Exactly ONE key check exists in the candy (measured: the run's six rpmfusion checks
name `RPM Fusion free signing key` and no nonfree equivalent), so this says one key
rather than the "two signing keys" an earlier draft claimed. Not a
developer image, not a demo: one candy, one service, one gate.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-sshd:v2026.272.0324`
